name: Dyaksa Peak ⛰️
desc:
Please read first the description of any features available in the map, and the following advice.

This map is said to be quite heavy for low End Device users, whether it's a smartphone or a PC/laptop, if you still want to try, it is recommended to lower the graphics settings on each player's device.
Then make sure your internet network is stable to render the content of this map.
This map is just fiction, but it's still a mountain and not just an obstacle.

There are 15 checkpoints nearby
🔥 spawn or spawn an avatar with a titan/giant version of the player at the top 
🔥 tittle for all Summit values 
🔥 playlist song 
🔥Manual graphics settings on the Low device at the top of the screen with the logo ⚙️ 
🔥Change the sky map privately in the menu settings ⚙️ screen 
🔥Alert button to request an upgrade 
🔥Confessionsboard
🔥 Free avatar menu that can be used for those who still use the default avatar from Roblox.
